title: Normalized scalar comparison for associated module sheaves
statement: Let C be a site with abelian sheafification and locally bijective sheafification equivalences. Let B,D be commutative rings, R,S ring sheaves, alpha:const B to R and beta:const D to S locally bijective scalar presentations, q:B to D and p:R to S with alpha followed by p = q followed by beta. Associated module sheafification commutes with restriction along q and p by a unique natural isomorphism whose components are the explicit maps extended from the abelian sheafification units (equivalently, inducing the identity on underlying abelian sheaves). Its application to consecutive quotient presentations, followed by composition of completed scalar restrictions and termwise derived localization, defines the canonical scalar compositor for [def-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-adic-scalar-realization].

source.place: Modules on Sites Tag 03CY; Cohomology on Sites Tag 06YY.

proof.text: Use the associated module sheafification adjunction to extend its unit to an R-linear map. Compatibility of q,p with alpha,beta gives linearity on constant sections. After forgetting scalars, precompose with the invertible abelian sheafification unit; this identifies the map with the identity. The forgetful functor reflects isomorphisms. Its faithfulness gives naturality and uniqueness. Apply the comparison on the slice and use the inverse-limit projection equation to compose completed restrictions, then localize exact functors termwise.
